$description: Analytics scope tokens (added by ds.py init when the analytics scope is enabled). Delta text aliases existing semantic text tokens, which already adapt in dark and high-contrast themes, so no themes/ overrides ship. Delta color direction is not sentiment: whether up is good is defined by the metric, and the color mapping can be swapped per metric (e.g. cost up uses the danger token). Always pair with an arrow icon, a signed number and text.

up.$description: Positive-direction delta text; always paired with an arrow icon and a signed number.

down.$description: Negative-direction delta text; always paired with an arrow icon and a signed number.

flat.$description: No-change delta text; always paired with a flat icon and the number 0.
